candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 after ~2s because its call to order times out (transport ReadTimeout ~2s), and order's own call to payment also times out (~2s), so the failure originates in payment authorization latency propagating up through order to the gateway.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side spans/metrics are absent; the payment timeout is inferred from order's client span, not directly observed on payment.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s (~2s) align with gateway->order transport ReadTimeout (~2s); order->payment also shows transport ReadTimeout (~2s) while inventory/redis calls succeed quickly. Topology confirms gateway->order->payment. This points to downstream latency originating at payment, propagating to order and gateway. Payment-side telemetry is missing, so confidence is moderate.
missing_evidence: Payment service traces/metrics showing authorization latency or saturation to confirm payment as the origin
Order service server-side spans/logs to confirm it is a victim rather than the source of the ~2s delay
Baseline latency for payment /v1/authorizations to distinguish regression from steady state
